positive_snippets: If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! When another hotel failed to honor my booking, Lemon Green went above and beyond to take care of me. Everything from the excellent, professional service to the clean, bright rooms was perfect. I highly recommend this place for all travelers, including foreigners. Thank you for making my stay in Delhi so enjoyable!
